title: Prisma | Agent Infrastructure for TypeScript
description: Prisma Compute hosts TypeScript apps (Node.js, Bun or Next.js) next to Prisma Postgres in one project. Generally available since August 2026. Free plan, no credit card. Any Postgres client works; Prisma ORM is optional. Prisma makes Prisma ORM, Prisma Postgres and Prisma Compute.
